title: design/1: the experimental design of a series
description: Conditions, reference, comparisons, factors and batches as data of the plan (mzlab-core design). Proposed from a samples/1 by `propose`, confirmed by the user, checked by `validate` (codes only). Canonical JSON: keys in alphabetical order, factors sorted by name, batches sorted by sha256 then file; its SHA-256 enters prov/1. Field names in Italian, values in English, as samples/1.

conditions.description: the distinct series of the sample files, in the order of injection ('' = the only series)

replicates.description: the fewest sample files over the time points of the condition (derived)

levels.description: factor name -> value of that factor for this condition

kind.description: pair: a against b; vs_reference: every condition against the reference

batches.description: the batch of each file; the default is one batch called '1'

sha256.description: the key when known (as in samples/1); empty otherwise
